newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ knows no reason for shr price move.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ knows no reason for shr price move.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ) said on Thursday in response to an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) it knew of no reason for the strong rise in its share price today.

"I refer to your discussion ... this morning advising that our shares, having closed at A$9.22 last night, had been up to A$10.00 this morning and enquiring were we aware of any reason for this. We are not aware of any reason for the increase in the share price," ANZ said in a short statement to the ASX.
At 12.25 p.m. (0225 GMT), ANZ shares were 23 cents or 2.49 percent up at A$9.45 with over four million shares traded.
Brokers said earlier there were takeover rumours circulating in the market.
